ei.title: Analysis — 실물 상품 직접 투자의 문제점
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: When investors decide to buy physical goods, they follow a direct approach. This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price, but involves a cost. When investors buy commodities, they need to understand the quality of the goods and the problems that can exist if that quality is lacking. Another problem is the presence of different costs relating to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs. These costs affect the management of the physical good. As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, investors typically prefer to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets to avoid the problems linked to the management of physical goods.

questions.passage: When investors decide ①<u>to buy</u> physical goods, they follow a direct approach. This approach provides ②<u>the purest</u> exposure to the commodity's price, but involves a cost. When investors buy commodities, they need to understand the quality of the goods and ③<u>the problems that can existing</u> if that quality is lacking. Another problem is the presence of different ④<u>costs</u> relating to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs. These costs affect the management of the physical good. As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, investors typically prefer to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets to avoid the problems linked to the management of physical goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ can existing → can exist: 조동사 can 뒤에는 동사 원형 필요. existing(현재분사)은 불가 / ① to buy: decide to+원형 정상 / ② the purest: 최상급+명사 정상 / ④ costs: 복수명사 정상
det.analysis:
❌ ① to buy: 'decide to buy physical goods' — to부정사 정상
❌ ② the purest: 'the purest exposure' — 최상급 형용사 정상
✅ ③ can existing(오류): 'problems that can existing' — 조동사 can 뒤에는 반드시 동사 원형(exist). 현재분사 existing 불가 ← 정답
❌ ④ costs: 'cash opportunity costs' — 복수명사 정상
det.tip: 조동사(can/will/should) + 동사원형. can exist (O) / can existing (X)

questions.passage: When investors decide to buy physical goods, ①<u>they follow</u> a direct approach. This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price, but ②<u>involving</u> a cost. When investors buy commodities, they need to understand the quality of the goods and the problems that can exist ③<u>if that quality is lacking</u>. Another problem is the presence of different costs ④<u>relating to</u> storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs. These costs affect the management of the physical good. As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, investors typically prefer to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets to avoid the problems linked to the management of physical goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② involving → involves: 등위접속사 but으로 provides와 병렬 연결되므로 동사 involves가 맞음. involving(분사)은 병렬 구조 위반 / ① they follow: 주어+동사 정상 / ③ if that quality is lacking: 자동사 lack의 진행형 정상 / ④ relating to: 현재분사 수식 정상
det.analysis:
❌ ① they follow: 'they follow a direct approach' — 복수주어+동사원형 정상
✅ ② involving(오류): 'This approach provides...but involving a cost' — but 등위접속사로 provides와 병렬이므로 동사 involves 필요. involving(분사)은 병렬 구조 파괴 ← 정답
❌ ③ if that quality is lacking: lack 자동사 진행형. 품질이 부족한 상태. 정상
❌ ④ relating to: 'costs relating to storage' — 현재분사 후치 수식 정상
det.tip: 등위접속사(and/but/or)는 같은 문법 구조를 연결. provides...but involves (동사+동사)

questions.passage: When investors decide to buy physical goods, they follow a direct approach. This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price, but involves ①<u>a cost</u>. When investors buy commodities, they need to understand the quality of the goods and the problems that can exist if that quality is lacking. Another problem is ②<u>the presence</u> of different costs relating to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs. These costs ③<u>affect</u> the management of the physical good. As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, ④<u>investors typically prefer indirectly assuming</u> a position in commodity markets to avoid the problems linked to the management of physical goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ prefer indirectly assuming → prefer to indirectly assume: prefer to V(~하는 것을 선호하다)가 원문 구조. prefer + V-ing도 가능하나 원문은 to부정사 구조이고, 부사 indirectly가 분사 앞에 오면 의미가 모호해짐. 또한 assume a position은 to부정사로 목적을 나타내는 것이 자연스러움 / ① a cost: 단수 비한정 명사 정상 / ② the presence: 한정 명사 정상 / ③ affect: 복수주어 These costs + 동사원형 정상
det.analysis:
❌ ① a cost: 'but involves a cost' — 단수 불가산→가산 명사. 비용이라는 개념. 정상
❌ ② the presence: 'the presence of different costs' — of구 선행 명사. 정상
❌ ③ affect: 'These costs affect the management' — 복수주어+원형동사 정상
✅ ④ prefer indirectly assuming(오류): 원문 'prefer to indirectly assume a position' — prefer to+원형이 원문 구조. 또한 indirectly assuming a position은 동명사 앞 부사 위치가 부자연스러우며, to avoid로 이어지는 목적절과의 연결도 어색해짐 ← 정답
det.tip: prefer to V = ~하기를 선호하다. prefer V-ing도 문법적으로 가능하나, 원문 구조와 뒤따르는 to avoid 목적절과의 연결을 고려하면 to V가 적합

questions.passage: When investors decide to buy physical goods, they follow a ①<u>indirect</u> approach. This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price, but involves a cost. When investors buy ②<u>commodities</u>, they need to understand the quality of the goods and the problems that can exist if that quality is lacking. Another problem is the presence of different costs relating to storage, ③<u>insurance</u>, and cash opportunity costs. These costs affect the management of the physical good. As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, investors typically ④<u>prefer</u> to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets to avoid the problems linked to the management of physical goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① indirect → direct: 실물 상품을 직접 구매하는 것은 '직접(direct)' 접근 방식. indirect(간접)는 문맥 오류 / ② commodities: 상품 구매 문맥 적절 / ③ insurance: 보관·보험·기회비용 나열 적절 / ④ prefer: 간접 투자를 선호 적절
det.analysis:
✅ ① indirect(오류): 'they follow an indirect approach' — 투자자가 실물 상품을 직접 사는 행위인데 '간접(indirect)' 접근이라 하면 모순. 원문 direct(직접)가 정확 ← 정답
❌ ② commodities: 'When investors buy commodities' — 상품 구매 문맥 적절
❌ ③ insurance: 'storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs' — 보험 비용 적절
❌ ④ prefer: 'investors typically prefer to indirectly assume' — 간접 투자 선호 적절
det.tip: 실물 상품 직접 구매 = direct approach. 간접(indirect)은 뒷부분에서 설명하는 대안적 방법.

questions.passage: When investors decide to buy physical goods, they follow a direct approach. This approach provides the purest ①<u>exposure</u> to the commodity's price, but involves a cost. When investors buy commodities, they need to understand the ②<u>quality</u> of the goods and the problems that can exist if that quality is lacking. Another problem is the presence of different costs relating to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs. These costs affect the management of the physical good. As a result of the ③<u>advantages</u> of direct investment, investors typically prefer to indirectly ④<u>assume</u> a position in commodity markets to avoid the problems linked to the management of physical goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ advantages → disadvantages: 직접 투자의 '단점(disadvantages)' 때문에 간접 투자를 선호. advantages(장점)면 간접 투자 선호 이유가 성립 안 됨 / ① exposure: 가격 노출 적절 / ② quality: 상품 품질 적절 / ④ assume: 입지를 취하다 적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① exposure: 'the purest exposure to the commodity's price' — 가격에 대한 노출. 적절
❌ ② quality: 'understand the quality of the goods' — 상품 품질 파악 필요. 적절
✅ ③ advantages(오류): 'As a result of the advantages of direct investment, investors prefer to indirectly assume...' — 장점(advantages) 때문에 간접 투자를 선호? 논리 모순. 단점(disadvantages) 때문에 간접 투자 선호가 맞음 ← 정답
❌ ④ assume: 'assume a position in commodity markets' — 시장에서 입지를 취하다. 적절
det.tip: 인과관계 파악: 직접 투자의 단점(disadvantages) → 간접 투자 선호. 장점(advantages)이면 인과 역전.

questions.passage: When investors decide to buy physical goods, they follow a direct approach. This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price, but involves a cost. When investors buy commodities, they need to understand the quality of the goods and the problems that can exist if that quality is lacking. Another problem is the presence of different costs relating to __________. These costs affect the management of the physical good. As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, investors typically prefer to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets to avoid the problems linked to the management of physical goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs: 직접 투자와 관련된 다양한 비용의 구체적 종류 / ① 상품 가격(앞 문장 내용) / ② 간접 투자 전략(뒷부분 내용) / ④ 상품 거래의 장점(언급 없음)
det.analysis:
❌ ① the commodity's price: S2에서 이미 언급된 별개의 내용. 빈칸 앞 'costs relating to'와 연결 안 됨
❌ ② indirect investment strategies: 간접 투자는 마지막 문장에서만 등장. 빈칸 위치와 무관
✅ ③ storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs: 'Another problem is the presence of different costs relating to ____' — 다양한 비용의 구체적 내용. 보관, 보험, 현금 기회비용 ← 정답
❌ ④ the advantages of commodity trading: 본문은 단점(disadvantages)을 다룸. 장점 언급 없음
det.tip: 'different costs relating to...'에서 relating to 뒤에는 비용의 구체적 종류가 와야 함.

ch: storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs

questions.passage: When investors decide to buy physical goods, they follow a direct approach. This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price, but involves a cost. When investors buy commodities, they need to understand the quality of the goods and the problems that can exist if that quality is lacking. Another problem is the presence of different costs relating to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs. These costs affect the management of the physical good. As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, investors typically prefer to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets to avoid __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① the problems linked to the management of physical goods: 간접 투자를 선호하는 이유 = 실물 관리 문제 회피 / ② 실물 보유의 이점(본문 논지와 반대) / ③ 주식 직접 구매(주식 언급 없음) / ④ 글로벌 시장 가격 변동(언급 없음)
det.analysis:
✅ ① the problems linked to the management of physical goods: 'investors typically prefer to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets to avoid ____' — 간접 투자 선호 이유 = 실물 관리 문제 회피 ← 정답
❌ ② the benefits of holding physical commodities: 이점을 피한다? 논리적으로 부적절
❌ ③ the direct approach to buying stocks: 본문에 주식(stocks) 언급 없음
❌ ④ the price fluctuations in global markets: 글로벌 시장 가격 변동은 언급되지 않음
det.tip: to avoid + 목적어: 피하려는 대상 = 실물 관리의 문제점(problems). 인과관계 추론.

ch: the problems linked to the management of physical goods
the benefits of holding physical commodities
the direct approach to buying stocks
the price fluctuations in global markets

questions.passage: When investors decide to buy physical goods, they follow a direct approach. This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price, but involves a cost. When investors buy commodities, they need to understand the quality of the goods and the problems that can exist if that quality is lacking. Another problem is the presence of different costs relating to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs. These costs affect the management of the physical good. As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, investors typically prefer to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets to avoid the problems linked to the management of physical goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ② 순수한 노출 = 직접 투자 장점 → 본문 일치 / ① 비용 안 듦 → 불일치(involves a cost) / ③ 품질 이해 불필요 → 불일치(need to understand) / ④ 보관만 → 불일치(보관+보험+기회비용)
det.analysis:
❌ ① 'but involves a cost' — 비용이 수반됨. 불일치
✅ ② 'This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price' — 가장 순수한 가격 노출 = 직접 투자 장점. 일치 ← 정답
❌ ③ 'they need to understand the quality of the goods' — 이해 필요. 불일치
❌ ④ 'costs relating to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs' — 보관 외에도 보험·기회비용. 불일치
det.tip: the purest exposure = 가장 순수한 노출. 직접 투자의 유일한 장점.

ch: 실물 상품 구매는 비용이 전혀 들지 않는 접근 방식이다.
직접 투자 방식은 상품 가격에 가장 순수하게 노출되는 방법이다.
투자자들은 상품의 품질을 이해할 필요가 없다.
보관 비용만이 실물 관리에 영향을 미치는 유일한 비용이다.

questions.passage: When investors decide to buy physical goods, they follow a direct approach. This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price, but involves a cost. When investors buy commodities, they need to understand the quality of the goods and the problems that can exist if that quality is lacking. Another problem is the presence of different costs relating to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs. These costs affect the management of the physical good. As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, investors typically prefer to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets to avoid the problems linked to the management of physical goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ④ 직접적 입지 선호 → 불일치. 본문: indirectly assume(간접적으로) 선호 / ① 직접 방식 → 일치 / ② 품질 부족 시 문제 → 일치 / ③ 비용이 관리에 영향 → 일치
det.analysis:
❌ ① 'they follow a direct approach' — 직접 방식. 일치
❌ ② 'the problems that can exist if that quality is lacking' — 품질 부족 시 문제. 일치
❌ ③ 'These costs affect the management of the physical good' — 비용이 관리에 영향. 일치
✅ ④ 본문: 'prefer to indirectly assume a position' — 간접적(indirectly)으로 입지를 잡는 것을 선호. '직접적으로'는 본문과 반대 ← 정답
det.tip: indirectly(간접적으로) ≠ directly(직접적으로). 핵심 부사 하나로 의미가 반전됨.

ch: 투자자들은 실물 상품을 살 때 직접적인 방식을 따른다.
상품 품질이 부족할 경우 문제가 발생할 수 있다.
다양한 비용이 실물 상품의 관리에 영향을 끼친다.
투자자들은 상품 시장에서 직접적으로 입지를 잡는 것을 더 선호한다.

questions.passage: When investors decide to buy physical goods, they follow a direct approach. This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price, but involves a cost. When investors buy commodities, they need to understand the quality of the goods and the problems that can exist if that quality is lacking. Another problem is the presence of different costs relating to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs. These costs affect the management of the physical good. As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, investors typically prefer to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets to avoid the problems linked to the management of physical goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ④ 장점 때문에 실물 시장 참여 → 불일치. 본문: disadvantages(단점) 때문에 간접 투자 선호 / ① 가격 노출 이점 → 일치 / ② 품질 위험 파악 → 일치 / ③ 현금 기회비용 → 일치
det.analysis:
❌ ① 'the purest exposure to the commodity's price' — 가격 노출 이점. 일치
❌ ② 'need to understand the quality of the goods and the problems' — 품질·문제 파악. 일치
❌ ③ 'cash opportunity costs' — 현금 기회비용 명시. 일치
✅ ④ 본문: 'As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment' — 단점(disadvantages) 때문에 간접 투자 선호. '장점 때문에 실물 시장 참여'는 반대 ← 정답
det.tip: disadvantages(단점) vs advantages(장점). 인과관계의 방향성이 핵심.

ch: 실물 상품의 직접 구매에는 상품 가격 노출이라는 이점이 있다.
투자자가 상품을 매입할 때 품질과 관련된 위험을 알아야 한다.
현금 기회비용은 실물 투자에서 발생하는 비용 중 하나이다.
직접 투자의 장점 때문에 투자자들은 실물 시장 참여를 더 원한다.

questions.passage: When investors decide to buy physical goods, they follow a direct approach. This approach provides the purest exposure to the commodity's price, but involves a cost. When investors buy commodities, they need to understand the quality of the goods and the problems that can exist if that quality is lacking. Another problem is the presence of different costs relating to storage, insurance, and cash opportunity costs. These costs affect the management of the physical good. As a result of the disadvantages of direct investment, investors typically prefer to indirectly assume a position in commodity markets to avoid the problems linked to the management of physical goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② 직접 투자 단점 + 간접 투자 선호 이유 = 글의 핵심 / ① 품질 관리 방법(구체적 방법 없음) / ③ 수익 전략(언급 없음) / ④ 비용 절감 기법(언급 없음)
det.analysis:
❌ ① 품질 관리 방법은 언급되지 않음. 품질 문제가 있다는 것만 서술
✅ ② 본문 구조: 직접 투자의 장점(purest exposure) → 그러나 비용과 단점(cost, quality, storage 등) → 결론: 간접 투자 선호. 핵심 주제와 일치 ← 정답
❌ ③ 높은 수익 전략은 본문에 전혀 언급되지 않음
❌ ④ 비용 절감 기법은 언급되지 않음. 비용의 존재만 서술

det.korean: ② 실물 직접 소유 → 시장 변동에 직접 영향 = 가장 순수한 가격 노출의 함축 / ① 가격 투명성(언급 없음) / ③ 품질 검사 절차(purest≠순도) / ④ 간접 투자가 더 정확(본문과 반대)

det.tip: purest exposure = 가장 순수한 노출. 실물 소유 = 중간 과정 없이 가격 변동에 직접 영향받음.
